vision.scope: shared image-to-text tool for all GLM-5.1 methods; receives only images and a fixed observation prompt; historical 75.1 is reference-only

skilllearnbench.method_scope_note: human_written omitted by author decision (2026-10-26); the Direct Oracle ablation runs on SkillsBench, not here
skilllearnbench.claim: held-out instances within seen task families
skilllearnbench.human_written_label: author-provided reference skills; train-only authorship not established
skilllearnbench.harness: shared OpenAI-compatible Docker tool agent with official environments and verifiers; not the original Claude CLI harness

skillopt.selection_protocol: fresh executions of instance 1; no held-out selection instances

direct_oracle.rounds_and_candidates: same max_rounds and max_candidates_per_round as skilllift; one oracle execution per valid candidate; at most 1 + max_rounds * max_candidates_per_round rollouts per cell before infrastructure retries
direct_oracle.acceptance: oracle reward improves; on equal reward, a higher oracle criterion pass fraction (replaces the SkillLift verifier tie-break)
direct_oracle.stopping: same as the SkillLift coordinator: anchor_terminal, terminal_candidate, two_no_improvement_rounds, round_budget_exhausted, all_candidates_invalid
direct_oracle.infrastructure_retries: TrainingOracle owns up to retry.oracle_max_attempts physical attempts; both optimizers use max_consecutive_infra_failures=1 to avoid multiplying that cap; an infrastructure failure is never a score

ablation.primary_metric: process_best: per-task best oracle score observed during evolution (anchor + candidates), the Table 2 definition; reported by `report` in process_best_summary.csv

skilllift.metric: mean per-task best evolved-skill score over 3 rollout seeds (paper Evaluation Protocol)

ablation.note: Author decision 2026-10-26: SkillsBench only. GLM-5.1 runs only Direct Oracle and is compared with the published Table 2 SkillLift result; DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash has no published SkillLift result, so both arms run and are also compared on paired independent finals. final_repeats=3 at this level is the Table 2 rebuild default and is not used by the ablation arms.

retry.transient: 429, 408, 409, 425, 5xx, connection reset/refused, timeouts; 400/401/403/404/413/422, quota exhaustion, 1210/1301, content filter and context overflow fail immediately
retry.resume: rerun the same command: finished jobs are skipped, failed/interrupted jobs relaunch, training cells replay <cell>/journal/training.jsonl; all attempts are kept

statistics.incomplete_cohorts: report coverage only; do not calculate CI or p

notes: 1 evolution_run by author decision (2026-10-26, time); this protocol does not estimate run-to-run variability. An evolution run is a fresh optimization process, not a retry.
The 2 internal SkillLift final trials are training-instance reevaluations, not held-out tests.
No skill, human-written and frozen LLM-written repeat execution once per run index; they are not re-authored.
Completed family/run cells resume by frozen content hash. Interrupted training cells restart in a new attempt.
Runtime estimates are planning assumptions, not measured guarantees. Review pilot costs and timing before the full run.
